items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: From 1953-64 he teamed with Frank Foster and Marshall Royal to solidify the great Basie sax section.

ctx.x: Yeah, I told him to call Eric because you know I was playing third alto, and he put me there because he knew I could play first if Marshall wasn’t there, you know, he always kept somebody in the third chair that could play lead, so that he would never be without a lead player, you know. So he kept changing, looking for a tenor player, and it was bugging me, you know, because I’d played the book for what five or six years, you know what I mean? I knew what it was supposed to be. And he got all these people coming…
Who were some of your favorite drummers and bass players during that period?
